Agent Name: Excel_Expert
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Misapplied the business logic by counting even-numbered street addresses for sunset awnings. Since the awnings are for the back of the house, a home with an east-facing front (odd number) has a west-facing back and thus needs the sunset design. Counting even numbers (west-facing fronts) reversed the criterion, yielding 4 instead of the correct 8.
